pages.title: Transfer Run
pages.text: $(bold)RECORDED AUDIO TRANSCRIPT$()$(br)Recovered from an evac vehicle.$(br)Permission: not required$(br2)VOICE 1: ORSA bolted that terminal into the station wall and then told us to drive ourselves to camp when the uplink died.$(br2)VOICE 2: They left Leon with the instruments.$(br)VOICE 1: He chose that. Said the logs mattered. I think he just knew this truck was worse odds.

pages.title: Breakdown
pages.text: VOICE 3: Temperature gauge is gone. Wind's coming through the firewall.$(br2)VOICE 2: Camp should be close enough to signal us.$(br2)VOICE 1: Camp isn't sending anyone. ORSA isn't sending anyone. That's the pattern.$(br2)The final audio is engine knock, rising argument, and the sound of the vehicle coasting into silence.
